lunch3_start.name: {name}
lunch3_start.text: *Lunch time. When the lunch box is opened, three people gather in one place. Seoyeon sits next to him, Dain sits across from him, and Yuna sneaks in, eating her bread in the corner.*

lunch3_meal_3.name: Seoyeon
lunch3_meal_3.text: The rolled omelette's a touch salty. Six out of ten.

lunch3_meal_5.name: Seoyeon
lunch3_meal_5.text: Out of ten. Six isn't bad, you know.

lunch3_meal_6.name: {name}
lunch3_meal_6.text: *Yuna silently reaches out with her chopsticks and takes the best-looking sausage.*

lunch3_meal_8.name: {name}
lunch3_meal_8.text: *Yuna quietly picks up her chopsticks. Faster than before. I've been raided. By all three at once.*

lunch3_meal_10.name: {name}
lunch3_meal_10.text: *Last piece of rolled omelet. 'Let's share,' I said. — The air dropped.*

lunch3_choice.name: {name}
lunch3_choice.text: *I ponder who to give the last side dish to.*

lunch3_give_seo_1.name: Seoyeon
lunch3_give_seo_1.text: ...Thanks. You do have a sense for these things.

lunch3_give_dain_2.name: Seoyeon
lunch3_give_dain_2.text: ...Unbelievable. And I even graded it for you.

lunch3_share_solo.name: {name}
lunch3_share_solo.text: *The three of us share it bit by bit. The last egg roll is split in half, and no one gets up first.*

lunch3_harem_1.name: {name}
lunch3_harem_1.text: *The three of us share it bit by bit. Seoyeon smiles politely, Dain is excessively bright, Yuna never takes out the note she folded.*

lunch3_expose_2.name: Dain
lunch3_expose_2.text: Oh right! {name}, you said you'd hit the arcade with me this weekend!! What should we eat first?!

lunch3_expose_3.name: {name}
lunch3_expose_3.text: *— I freeze. The other two stop their hands.*

lunch3_expose_4.name: {name}
lunch3_expose_4.text: *Seoyeon's chopsticks stop. Yuna's hand tearing bread stops.*

lunch3_expose_6.name: Seoyeon
lunch3_expose_6.text: You told me we had somewhere to go this weekend.

lunch3_expose_7.name: Dain
lunch3_expose_7.text: ...Wait. You said you'd hang out with me this weekend?

lunch3_expose_11.name: Yuna
lunch3_expose_11.text: ......That was a lie. I didn't know either.

lunch3_expose_12.name: {name}
lunch3_expose_12.text: *Three pairs of chopsticks freeze. The cafeteria noise suddenly sounds far away. At the next table, Minsu is looking over at us. He shakes his head.*

lunch3_expose_15.name: {name}
lunch3_expose_15.text: *The mouth does not fall. Minsu turns his head away.*

lunch3_expose_choice.name: {name}
choices: I'm sorry. You're all amazing — I just couldn't say no to any of you.
The times didn't overlap, so I figured it'd be fine...

lunch3_expose_honest_1.name: {name}
lunch3_expose_honest_1.text: I'm sorry. You're all amazing — I just couldn't say no to any of you.

lunch3_expose_honest_2.name: Seoyeon
lunch3_expose_honest_2.text: ...Not being able to say no. — That's the cruelest thing, {name}.

lunch3_expose_honest_3.name: Seoyeon
lunch3_expose_honest_3.text: Kindness that can't say no — that's just leading people on.

lunch3_expose_honest_5.name: Seoyeon
lunch3_expose_honest_5.text: I don't do gray areas. If that's how it is, count me out.

lunch3_expose_honest_7.name: {name}
lunch3_expose_honest_7.text: *There is no exclamation mark. The end of Dain's sentence is strangely quiet.*

lunch3_expose_excuse_1.name: {name}
lunch3_expose_excuse_1.text: The times didn't overlap, so I figured it'd be fine...

lunch3_expose_excuse_2.name: Seoyeon
lunch3_expose_excuse_2.text: ...You really don't see how that's the problem?

lunch3_expose_excuse_3.name: Dain
lunch3_expose_excuse_3.text: I need some time to think too.

lunch3_expose_excuse_4.name: {name}
lunch3_expose_excuse_4.text: *Dain turns her head away. She hasn't touched her crumble bun.*

lunch3_expose_run_1.name: {name}
lunch3_expose_run_1.text: *I push through the classroom door. Behind me, chairs scrape all at once.*

lunch3_expose_run_2.name: {name}
lunch3_expose_run_2.text: *The silence of three people behind me stabs into my back. All through afternoon class, the chalk sounds distant. Under my desk, my phone screen keeps lighting up and going dark.*

lunch3_end.name: {name}
lunch3_end.text: *Lunchtime's over. But nothing is actually over.*

lunch3_share_1.name: {name}
lunch3_share_1.text: *We all said we should share it together. All three laugh funny, but no one reaches out first.*

lunch3_seo_skin_1.name: {name}
lunch3_seo_skin_1.text: *While eating lunch, a grain of rice sticks to my lip. Seoyeon reaches over and picks it off.*

lunch3_seo_skin_2.name: Seoyeon
lunch3_seo_skin_2.text: ...Pay more attention when eating in front of people.

lunch3_seo_skin_3.name: {name}
lunch3_seo_skin_3.text: *After pulling her hand back, Seoyeon drops her chopsticks. — It looked natural, but her fingertips were trembling slightly.*

lunch3_seo_witness_1.name: {name}
lunch3_seo_witness_1.text: *Dain stops at the classroom door. She sees Seoyeon receiving the lunchbox. ...Oh. She turns back.*

lunch3_seo_witness_choice.name: {name}
lunch3_seo_witness_choice.text: *Dain's back is disappearing down the hallway.*

lunch3_seo_chase_dain_1.name: {name}
lunch3_seo_chase_dain_1.text: *Seoyeon sets down the lunchbox. Her face is expressionless.*

lunch3_dain_skin_1.name: {name}
lunch3_dain_skin_1.text: *Dain throws her arms wide, thrilled by her lunch-bet win. A hug. One second. She springs back, grabs her water bottle.*

lunch3_dain_witness_1.name: {name}
lunch3_dain_witness_1.text: *Yuna looks inside the gym from the hallway. Dain is smiling. Yuna walks away without saying anything. Next break, Yuna's seat is empty.*

lunch3_yuna_skin_1.name: {name}
lunch3_yuna_skin_1.text: *While handing me a note, Yuna grabs my hand. She doesn't let go.*

lunch3_yuna_skin_2.name: Yuna
lunch3_yuna_skin_2.text: ...This isn't about what's on the note. Just.

lunch3_yuna_skin_3.name: {name}
lunch3_yuna_skin_3.text: *She only lets go after the sentence ends.*

lunch3_yuna_witness_1.name: Seoyeon
lunch3_yuna_witness_1.text: I caught the smell of a lunchbox coming from the library. ...With Yuna?

lunch3_yuna_witness_2.name: {name}
lunch3_yuna_witness_2.text: *No flicker in her expression. — The stillness itself cuts.*

lunch3_start_2_b.name: Dain
lunch3_start_2_b.text: *She takes a big bite of the rolled omelette without hesitation.*

lunch3_meal_10_b.name: {name}
lunch3_meal_10_b.text: *No one gets up. There are smiles, but all three hesitate to pick up their chopsticks. Only one last side dish remains in the center of the lunchbox.*

lunch3_meal_10_c.name: {name}
lunch3_meal_10_c.text: *Seoyeon’s chopsticks stop for a moment. The face of the student council president soon returns, but the egg roll remains.*

lunch3_meal_10_d.name: {name}
lunch3_meal_10_d.text: *Dain says “All together?!” and laughs. Normally I would have dragged a chair, but today I didn't move from where I sat.*

lunch3_meal_10_e.name: {name}
lunch3_meal_10_e.text: *Yuna just nods. She writes on a note, folds it, and slips it into her pocket. Doesn't hand it over. Only a single pale-purple dot has bled through the edge of the paper.*

lunch3_expose_7_b.name: {name}
lunch3_expose_7_b.text: *The last one quietly puts hers down. Yuna sets her bread on the table.*

lunch3_expose_honest_4_b.name: {name}
lunch3_expose_honest_4_b.text: *Seoyeon's smile freezes. The tip of her chopsticks taps against the lid of her lunchbox.*
